evidence: Canidae made my dogs VERY SICK

New food and or changed formula's need to be introduced to animals slowly. Very slowly. However, I was not given this option by Canidae when I ran out of the old All Stages Life Dry Dog Food and purchased a new bag of the new formula (no warning label) with none of the old to mix in. That is the problem I'm having with my four dogs, 2 of which are 12 years old
assertions.comment: Большинство отзывов негативные, указывают на проблемы со здоровьем собак, что противоречит утверждению 'очень хороший'.
